title: Krein parity unitary with complete domains and functional calculus
summary: For fixed c>0, normalized even/odd restriction carries the current coupled Krein realization to Neumann-Neumann and Dirichlet-Robin half-interval operators, with all Borel-function domains transferred.
conditions: Half-interval operator domains are exactly those in proof01 P2; sqrt(2) normalization is part of U.
scope: This fixed coupled boundary realization; complex Hilbert spaces; Borel functional calculus and s>=0 power domains; negative scales only after completion.
content: Set fe=(f+Rf)/2, fo=(f-Rf)/2 and Uf=(sqrt(2)fe|_(0,1),sqrt(2)fo|_(0,1)). U is onto unitary. Ae=-D^2+c has g'(0)=g'(1)=0; Ao=-D^2+c has h(0)=0,h'(1)=h(1). U D(Kc)=D(Ae) direct-sum D(Ao), and U Kc U^-1=Ae direct-sum Ao. For every Borel F, the analogous equality includes the full domains of F(Kc),F(Ae),F(Ao). Both affine c-eigenmodes must be included. No sparse-family density conclusion follows solely from this equivalence.

sources.locator: Hyp2.1 and Thm2.4, pp10-13; use Kc/c to normalize
